progress.title: Download Progress
progress.retryHint: Red blocks can be clicked to retry - auto-retry every 2 seconds

empty.title: No download tasks

empty.hint: Supports M3U8/HLS, MP4, and other video formats

settings.title: Download Settings
settings.description: Customize download behavior, settings are saved automatically
settings.concurrencyHint: Number of segments downloaded in parallel (1-20)
settings.timeoutHint: Maximum wait time per segment request (5-120s)
settings.maxRetriesHint: Number of retry attempts per failed segment (0-10)
settings.retryDelayHint: Initial delay before retry, doubles each attempt (0.5-10s)
settings.maxTasksHint: How many downloads run at the same time. Each one opens up to the connection count below.
